notes.title: Re-cut on IA 3.5.0
notes.summary: The plugin, its tools and its tests pin `@inventarch/cli` 3.5.0, the IA door starts `@inventarch/mcp-door@3.5.0`, and the qualified runtime cohort is regenerated for 3.5.0 (decision `public-cli-3-5-0`). The language base is unchanged: `inventarch/language` 3.2.0.

notes.title: Re-cut the bundled kits
notes.summary: `ia-method` 0.7.1, `ia-kb` 0.9.1 and `ia-authoring` 0.1.1 are packed with the 3.5.0 CLI and published together as `@inventarch/public-kits` 1.0.1. No kit code reaches outside its own folder, and the `ia-method` and `ia-kb` case evaluators name tests in this repository.

notes.title: Ship the upkeep agent
notes.summary: `agents/upkeep.md` and `scripts/upkeep.mjs` ship, stating what the agent does and where it stops (decision `public-upkeep-agent`).

notes.title: The lanes call only the IA door
notes.summary: The work, knowledge and delivery lanes call `ia_session`, `ia_catalogue` and `ia_method` on the door and no longer fall back to `scripts/resolve.mjs`.

notes.title: Turn the IA door on under Codex
notes.summary: The Codex manifest names `.codex-mcp.json`, which starts the door with `node ./scripts/door.mjs`, because Codex does not expand the plugin-root variable (decision `public-door-codex`). Kit handler hooks stay off under Codex.

notes.title: Give the plugin README the catalogue's header
notes.summary: The plugin README opens with a title, a version badge, the pinned CLI and the licence, like the catalogue README. No behaviour changes.
